hand-wraps-spruce-ddpat.name: ★ Hand Wraps | Spruce DDPAT
hand-wraps-spruce-ddpat.desc:
Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching. The outer wrap is fabric screen printed with grey digital camo.

Some people say they're tough... others show it

hand-wraps-giraffe.name: ★ Hand Wraps | Giraffe
hand-wraps-giraffe.desc: Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching.

driver-gloves-hand-sweaters.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Hand Sweaters
driver-gloves-hand-sweaters.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

driver-gloves-imperial-plaid.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Imperial Plaid
driver-gloves-imperial-plaid.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation. This pair of flannel and leather gloves has an imperial hue.

ak-47-searing-rage.name: AK-47 | Searing Rage
ak-47-searing-rage.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. This custom, art brut paint job depicts the scattered thoughts of a once sane member of the Elite Crew.

RU$HKILLxDESTROY//NOxFEAR-ATTACKBURN!TERROR

aug-random-access.name: AUG | Random Access
aug-random-access.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A red circuit board pattern has been applied over a black base.

The journey is random; the result is not

aug-torque.name: AUG | Torque
aug-torque.desc: Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been custom painted with a robotics inspired pattern.

aug-snake-pit.name: AUG | Snake Pit
aug-snake-pit.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A custom pattern of snakes and amphibians has been applied.

Acting on ill intentions

bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Bayonet | Gamma Doppler
bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-4.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

pp-bizon-breaker-box.name: PP-Bizon | Breaker Box
pp-bizon-breaker-box.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. An anodized pattern of a wiring diagram has been applied.

Please consult an electrician before conducting your own repairs

pp-bizon-photic-zone.name: PP-Bizon | Photic Zone
pp-bizon-photic-zone.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been given a custom camouflage pattern accented with florescent paint.

That's not crashing waves you hear...

pp-bizon-bizoom.name: PP-Bizon | Bizoom
pp-bizon-bizoom.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. A grayscale pattern has been applied.

Quickly, please!

desert-eagle-mudder.name: Desert Eagle | Mudder
desert-eagle-mudder.desc: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted in a marbleized pattern.

dual-berettas-shred.name: Dual Berettas | Shred
dual-berettas-shred.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been spray painted with white and blue streaks on a black base.

Sometimes the gnar shreds you

famas-eye-of-athena.name: FAMAS | Eye of Athena
famas-eye-of-athena.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. A hand painted mechanized owl sits atop a nest of orange and brown feathers.

+1 to Wisdom

famas-halftone-wash.name: FAMAS | Halftone Wash
famas-halftone-wash.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been custom painted with a blue and grey halftone splash pattern.

Even the calmest waters can quickly change

famas-calicamo.name: FAMAS | CaliCamo
famas-calicamo.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

five-seven-jungle.name: Five-SeveN | Jungle
five-seven-jungle.desc: Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a jungle color scheme.

five-seven-withered-vine.name: Five-SeveN | Withered Vine
five-seven-withered-vine.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been spray-painted with a flower pattern in purple and gold.

Some see a nuisance; I see beauty

g3sg1-scavenger.name: G3SG1 | Scavenger
g3sg1-scavenger.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. Originally green, parts of the weapon have been replaced with street signs and a tomato can.

Why run?

galil-ar-nv.name: Galil AR | NV
galil-ar-nv.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been custom painted with a dark grey base and finished with green accents.

Going dark

glock-18-gamma-doppler-emerald.name: Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler
glock-18-gamma-doppler-emerald.desc: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

glock-18-glockingbird.name: Glock-18 | Glockingbird
glock-18-glockingbird.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with a silver mockingbird over a green and yellow base.

Let nothing stop your song

survival-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Survival Knife | Doppler
survival-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

falchion-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Doppler
falchion-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

falchion-knife-freehand.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Freehand
falchion-knife-freehand.desc: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted black and purple, then decorated with a metallic marker.

navaja-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Case Hardened
navaja-knife-case-hardened.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

karambit-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Karambit | Doppler
karambit-doppler-phase-3.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

karambit-gamma-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Karambit | Gamma Doppler
karambit-gamma-doppler-phase-3.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

karambit-marble-fade.name: ★ Karambit | Marble Fade
karambit-marble-fade.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

karambit-safari-mesh.name: ★ Karambit | Safari Mesh
karambit-safari-mesh.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

m9-bayonet-autotronic.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Autotronic
m9-bayonet-autotronic.desc: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been anodized red and uses steel mesh to lighten the weight.

nomad-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Case Hardened
nomad-knife-case-hardened.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

shadow-daggers-gamma-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler
shadow-daggers-gamma-doppler-phase-4.desc: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

stiletto-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Doppler
stiletto-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

bowie-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel
bowie-knife-damascus-steel.desc: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has some damascus steel parts.

bowie-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Forest DDPAT
bowie-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

m4a4-polysoup.name: M4A4 | Polysoup
m4a4-polysoup.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with multicolored crystals and finished with pearlescent accents.

Don't stew on it

mac-10-monkeyflage.name: MAC-10 | Monkeyflage
mac-10-monkeyflage.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. Red, tan, and green monkeys adorn this custom painted MAC-10.

Spunky monkeys!

mp5-sd-oxide-oasis.name: MP5-SD | Oxide Oasis
mp5-sd-oxide-oasis.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. A brightly-colored orange and teal camouflage pattern has been applied. The weapon has been finished with gold accents.

A weapon this quiet shouldn't be so loud

mp7-motherboard.name: MP7 | Motherboard
mp7-motherboard.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. A green and white circuit board pattern has been applied.

Stay connected

mp7-guerrilla.name: MP7 | Guerrilla
mp7-guerrilla.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. This custom paint job features a green base, black details and a forward-facing monkey.

The lion was never king of the jungle

mp7-scorched.name: MP7 | Scorched
mp7-scorched.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

nova-toy-soldier.name: Nova | Toy Soldier
nova-toy-soldier.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been hand painted a familiar shade of green to evoke childhood memories.

Pellets and soldiers delivered in bulk

nova-sand-dune.name: Nova | Sand Dune
nova-sand-dune.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a sand dune color scheme.

With Turner dead, we have a new priority: rescue Alex Kincaide - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

p250-digital-architect.name: P250 | Digital Architect
p250-digital-architect.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A multicolored pattern of an isometric grid has been applied.

You remember pain, I remember victory

p90-neoqueen.name: P90 | Neoqueen
p90-neoqueen.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted using a mix of military and sci-fi styles.

Custom crafted for all your rushing needs

r8-revolver-bone-mask.name: R8 Revolver | Bone Mask
r8-revolver-bone-mask.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

sawed-off-serenity.name: Sawed-Off | Serenity
sawed-off-serenity.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been hand painted with the image of a woman with wings.

Serenity is a luxury few can afford - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

sg-553-wave-spray.name: SG 553 | Wave Spray
sg-553-wave-spray.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. This memento from Seaside has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors.

Perfect for the insurgent on the go

ssg-08-blush-pour.name: SSG 08 | Blush Pour
ssg-08-blush-pour.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. A blush, gold, and blue-colored acrylic pour pattern has been applied.

It all comes together...

zeus-x27-electric-blue.name: Zeus x27 | Electric Blue
zeus-x27-electric-blue.desc:
Perfect for close-range ambushes and enclosed area encounters, the rechargeable x27 Zeus is capable of incapacitating an enemy in a single hit. It has been painted solid blue.

Lacking subtlety

ump-45-houndstooth.name: UMP-45 | Houndstooth
ump-45-houndstooth.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. A brown houndstooth hydrographic pattern has been applied.

Equip for the role you want, not the role you have

usp-s-business-class.name: USP-S | Business Class
usp-s-business-class.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with colors and patterns inspired by vintage luggage, and had some parts wrapped in brown leather.

Some people don't just want extra leg room... they want peace and quiet

usp-s-guardian.name: USP-S | Guardian
usp-s-guardian.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been painted cobalt blue and stenciled with the CT logo on the magazine.

I don't have to like you, I have to keep you safe - Carmen Cocinero, Extraction Expert

usp-s-whiteout.name: USP-S | Whiteout
usp-s-whiteout.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It is spray-painted all white.

It looks pure, but looks can be deceiving

xm1014-ziggy.name: XM1014 | Ziggy
xm1014-ziggy.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been finished with a randomized pattern of chartreuse, purple, and silver.

Introduce a little anarchy

xm1014-seasons.name: XM1014 | Seasons
xm1014-seasons.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been hand painted with a randomized multicolored leaf pattern.

Spring, summer, fall, and rarely winter

xm1014-tranquility.name: XM1014 | Tranquility
xm1014-tranquility.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been hand painted with the image of a woman with long hair.

I'm not here for what I need; I'm here for something I want - Imogen and The Oni Part 2

xm1014-copperflage.name: XM1014 | Copperflage
xm1014-copperflage.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A green and brown DDPAT pattern has been applied to the stock, grip, and handguard. 

All day long you'll have good luck
